# A01-S02: Party proposal

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

I hope all is well, and that you have a good Christmas lead-up. [████] I have also seen that you have a new .com website on the way, that the venture company is separated from the Tech Hub[████]

I’m probably just writing to keep in touch, and hear how far you have come with the new setup. I still get ideas continuously, which could work in your direction, if and to the extent 18th SDG still plays a role. I still hope for an interaction with my ‘Marcel Proust/Computer Lars’ text (which is getting deeply into artificial stupidity by describing all the Danes named Lars who work with computers), where I would like to involve some of your tech environment. Besides that, I have thought about the goal of ‘creating a global debate’, and whether MindFuture should not undertake an art project, founding a party with a chatbot as leader. Would create a stir, and The Transhumanist Party, for example, does not yet have a Danish branch.

I have gotten quite a bit of time to pursue the freer projects, because with the current 10%cuts at the universities (which mainly hit the humanities) after corona, there are practically no research funds and announced positions in circulation.

But I hope the processes go well, and that you are soon ready for relaunch.
